newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian kidnapping spawns kickboxing supernannies.
newsitem.headline: Russian kidnapping spawns kickboxing supernannies.

text.p: A new generation of kick-boxing "super-nannies" is being trained in Russia to combat a rise in the kidnapping of children, Mayak Radio Station said on Wednesday.
A St Petersburg teacher training institute has begun three-month courses in conjunction with a local kick-boxing association.
Demand for the streetwise nannies has been created by 138 cases of kidnapping or assault against young children in Russia's second city over the last year.
